population.note: Tier construction uses files with >= 1 chunk (8,527 measured), not the files-table total (8,651) — see the logged deviation in this script's header comment. The 124-file gap is 122 legitimately chunkless files plus the 2 known whale-fixture write failures.

cut_rule: prefix length minimizing |cumulative_chunk_count - target|, ties broken toward the smaller (earlier) index
